issues.t: Hybrid engine failure can lead to an engine fire (recalls)
issues.sym: A sudden loud knock or bang from the engine, loss of power, warning lights, and smoke from under the hood.
issues.why: If the 2.5L hybrid engine fails internally (often a connecting-rod bearing), oil and fuel vapor can escape and catch fire on hot engine or exhaust parts. Ford first changed the under-engine shield and grille shutters, then added software that limits power and alerts the driver, and replaces the engine if a failure is found.
issues.next: If you hear a sudden engine noise or see smoke, pull over, shut the truck off and get out. Check your VIN for recalls 22V-484, 23V-380 and 25V-345; some trucks fixed earlier need the newer repair.

issues.t: Hybrid truck can shift itself into Neutral (recalls)
issues.sym: While driving, the truck suddenly loses drive power and coasts, usually with warning messages on the dash.
issues.why: A software fault in the hybrid powertrain control module can command Neutral unexpectedly. Ford updated the software, then redid some of those repairs.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 24V-330 and 25V-133. If it happens, steer to a safe spot and restart the truck.

issues.t: 12V battery can die without warning (recalls)
issues.sym: Slow cranking or a truck that will not start, accessories shutting off, battery warnings, and in some cases a loss of drive power.
issues.why: The truck's control modules may not notice when the small 12V battery is running low, and some batteries degrade and fail suddenly. This is common on the hybrid. Ford recalled the trucks to reprogram the modules and test or replace the battery.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 24V-267, 24V-590, 25V-019, 25V-127 and 25V-158. Have the 12V battery tested if it is slow to start.

issues.t: Front ball joint can separate from the knuckle (do-not-drive recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or knocking from the front, wandering or uneven steering. If it separates, a front wheel can fold under the truck.
issues.why: Some front lower ball joints may have been installed or repaired incorrectly and can pull out of the steering knuckle.
issues.next: Do not drive the truck until it is inspected. Check your VIN for recall 26V-340 and ask the dealer about towing.

issues.t: Fuel tank may have drill holes from bedliner install (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell around the truck or fuel dripping near the tank.
issues.why: On some 2022 trucks, holes drilled while fitting the bedliner may have punctured the fuel tank.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, do not park inside. Check your VIN for recall 21V-976.

issues.t: Fuel tank seam can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell, wet spots or drips under the truck, or a warning light.
issues.why: The pinched seam on some fuel tanks may not be sealed and can leak gasoline.
issues.next: If you see a leak or a warning, park outside, shut the truck off and call the dealer. Check your VIN for recall 24V-185.

issues.t: Engine block heater can crack and short out (recall)
issues.sym: Coolant leaking near the block heater or the outlet tripping when it is plugged in.
issues.why: The factory block heater can crack, leak coolant and short-circuit when plugged in, which is a fire risk.
issues.next: Do not plug in the block heater until the recall is done. Check your VIN for recall 25V-685.

issues.t: Engine block heater can overheat when plugged in (recall)
issues.sym: A hot or burning smell near the front of the truck or the cord while the block heater is plugged in.
issues.why: The block heater element fitted to 2.0L trucks may overheat when in use.
issues.next: Stop using the block heater until the dealer replaces it. Check your VIN for recalls 25V-343 and 26V-239.

issues.t: Backup camera blank, frozen or stuck on (recalls)
issues.sym: The backup camera shows a blank or frozen picture in reverse, or stays on the screen after you shift out of reverse.
issues.why: Software faults in the camera and radio system. Ford fixes them with software updates.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 24V-684 and 25V-442. Look behind you and use your mirrors until it is fixed.

issues.t: Instrument cluster may not show warnings or gauges (recalls)
issues.sym: Gauges or warning lights do not light up when they should.
issues.why: A software fault in the instrument cluster of hybrid trucks. Ford updated the software, then redid some of those repairs.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 24V-140 and 25V-123.

issues.t: Tail lights can go out (recalls)
issues.sym: One or both tail lights stop working, making the truck harder to see at night.
issues.why: The body control module software can switch off the tail lights. Ford updated the software, then redid some repairs.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 24V-293 and 25V-095. Check your lights regularly.

issues.t: Turn signal does not warn when a bulb fails (recalls)
issues.sym: A rear turn signal stops working but the dash indicator keeps flashing at the normal rate, so you do not notice.
issues.why: Body control module software does not speed up the flash rate when a turn signal fails, as federal rules require.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 23V-848 and 25V-094.

issues.t: Trailer brakes or lights may stop working (recalls)
issues.sym: Trailer brakes do not apply, or the trailer lights or brake controller lose connection.
issues.why: Software faults in the trailer brake controller or trailer module. Recalls 22V-193 and 25V-132 cover 2022 trucks, and 26V-104 covers 2022-2026 trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN before towing. Test the trailer brakes and lights at low speed after hooking up.

issues.t: Brake lights can come on without braking (recalls)
issues.sym: The brake lights turn on while you are not pressing the brake, which can confuse drivers behind you.
issues.why: A software problem in the ABS module. Ford updated it, then redid some repairs.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 22V-730 and 25V-124.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may not deploy properly (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptoms; you may see an airbag warning light.
issues.why: Side curtain airbags on some early trucks may not deploy correctly in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-594.

issues.t: Rear seat belt buckles may not be attached (recall)
issues.sym: A rear seat belt buckle may feel loose or come away.
issues.why: Some rear seat belt buckles were not fastened properly at the factory.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-979.

issues.t: Front axle shaft failure
issues.sym: Clicking when turning, clunking or vibration on acceleration, or the truck losing drive.
issues.why: Owners report front drive (axle) shafts wearing out or breaking, at about 61,000 miles on average.
issues.next: Have the axle shafts and CV boots checked if you hear clicking in turns. A torn boot caught early is cheaper than a failed shaft.

issues.t: Rodents chewing engine wiring
issues.sym: Warning lights, things that stop working, or a no-start after the truck has been parked; chewed wires or nesting material under the hood.
issues.why: Rodents chew wiring insulation under the hood. It is the most reported Maverick problem on CarComplaints, at about 6,000 miles on average.
issues.next: Look under the hood for nests or droppings. Rodent repellent tape and traps help; check whether your insurance covers rodent damage.

issues.t: Roof trim strip comes loose
issues.sym: A roof trim strip flaps, rattles or blows off while driving.
issues.why: Owners report the roof molding coming loose very early, about 1,000 miles on average.
issues.next: Have it replaced under warranty before it blows off and damages paint or another car.

issues.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers slow down, stop partway, or do not work at all.
issues.why: The front wiper motor may fail.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-594. Do not drive in rain or snow if the wipers fail.

issues.t: Tires may have a manufacturing defect (recall)
issues.sym: Bulges, vibration or unusual wear on the original tires.
issues.why: Some factory tires were made incorrectly, which can hurt handling.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-223.

issues.t: Trailer tail lights may not work (recall)
issues.sym: The trailer's tail lights do not light up when towing.
issues.why: A circuit was left out of the trailer wiring harness on some 2023 trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 23V-160 and test trailer lights before each trip.

issues.t: Rear child seat tether anchors may not hold (recall)
issues.sym: A child seat top tether may not lock in securely.
issues.why: The second-row tether anchors may not fully engage.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-778 before using child seats in the back.

issues.t: Cylinder head plugs can leak oil (recall)
issues.sym: Oil on the engine or under the truck, burning oil smell, or a low oil warning.
issues.why: Ball plugs in some cylinder heads may not seal and can leak oil, which can cause a fire or engine damage.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-828.

issues.t: Brake booster unit can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights for brakes or stability control and a harder brake pedal.
issues.why: The cover on the electronic brake booster's control unit can overheat, which can turn off brake assist or stability control.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-787. Leave extra stopping distance until it is fixed.

issues.t: EGR valve can fail and cut engine power (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of power, reduced-power mode and a check-engine light.
issues.why: The exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve may fail.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-122.

issues.t: Truck may not lock into Park (recall)
issues.sym: The truck may roll after you shift into Park and get out.
issues.why: The integrated park module may not engage Park. Ford fixes it with a software update.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake until the recall is done. Check your VIN for recall 25V-863.

issues.t: Dash cover can break apart when the airbag deploys (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms until a crash.
issues.why: The instrument panel cover may separate when the passenger airbag deploys, sending pieces into the cab.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-884.

issues.t: Passenger airbag sensor may misread who is in the seat (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status light may show the wrong state.
issues.why: The passenger seat occupant sensor may not classify the person correctly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-201. Keep children in the back seat.

issues.t: Moonroof glass may come loose (recall)
issues.sym: Wind noise or a loose moonroof panel, often with no warning.
issues.why: The moonroof glass may not be bonded to its frame correctly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-157.

issues.t: Body or suspension joints may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Rattles, clunks or a loose feeling while driving.
issues.why: Some bolted joints may not have been tightened properly at the factory.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-550.
